about.after_an_app_update_or_process: After an app update or process restart, saving waits until you choose Start saving. Returning to an active save keeps its progress visible.
about.asked_for_the_apps_log_save: Asked for the app’s log? Save log for support puts it in one file in your Downloads folder, to attach to an email. It has the app’s own messages and each site’s series and episode numbers, but no titles, folder names or sign-in details.
about.asking_for_help_this_copies_a: Asking for help? This copies a short summary of each site’s download to paste into your message: the app’s version, counts and the app’s own codes. It has no series titles, folder names or sign-in details.
about.b2_storage_uses_your_own_private: B2 storage uses your own private bucket. Connect and pass the upload/readback test before choosing it as a destination.
about.choose_a_source_site_above_each: Choose a source site above. Each site keeps its sign-in and library separate.
about.comic_archiver_saves_cbz_and_epub: Comic Archiver saves CBZ and EPUB files. Use Open to read a saved file in another app.
about.could_not_open_the_faq_check: Could not open the FAQ. Check that a browser is available and try again.
about.export_copies_finished_archives_in: Export copies finished archives into a folder you choose and verifies each copy. Export keeps your originals in the app.
about.include_this_version_and_fingerpri: Include this version and fingerprint when reporting a problem.
about.long_saves_can_be_stopped_by: Long saves can be stopped by the system after a while; choosing Start saving continues them.
about.on_devices_without_isolated_browse: On devices without isolated browser profiles, saved libraries remain available; sign-in needs an updated Android System WebView.
about.opening_a_working_library_makes_a: Opening a working library makes a separate copy in the app. The selected source is unchanged; refreshing it makes another working copy.
about.other_cloud_providers_image_qualit: Other cloud providers, image-quality options and listing services are not supported yet.
about.read_the_official_tapas_closure_fa: Read the official Tapas closure FAQ
about.reading_positions_and_bookmarks_st: Reading positions and bookmarks stay with the working library. Export copies finished archives; it does not copy reading progress.
about.saving_from_tapas_needs_an_up: Saving from Tapas needs an up-to-date Android System WebView. If Tapas will not start, update it in the Play Store.
about.saving_uses_unmetered_connections_: Saving uses unmetered connections by default. Settings lets you allow mobile data.
about.tapas_closes_at_the_end_of: Tapas closes at the end of March 2027; save what you bought before then.
about.tapas_recent_and_free_episodes_dis: Tapas Recent and Free Episodes discovery and Fast mode need an updated Android System WebView. Settings shows whether Fast can run on this device.
about.uninstalling_removes_app_private_l: Uninstalling removes app-private libraries and sign-ins. Files already copied to your chosen export folder or verified in your B2 bucket stay there.
about.what_this_beta_does_not_do: What this beta does not do
